g.text: poll the PAD until SCL reads high
sample SDA at the end of the high
the 9th clock: the MASTER drives SDA
main: LDM A,10 then a cumulative SUB A,1 / JZ chain,
SDA set while SCL is low
poll the PAD until SCL reads high
if a 1 was sent, read SDA back;
tSU;STO 6, poll SCL, release SDA, tBUF 6
then dmem[15] = 0xA5 if dmem[1..4] are all 0x00,
The pin discipline here is the whole
trap of a read burst. The 9th clock is
a rising edge, so SDA must HOLD across
it: an ACK keeps SDA driven low and
releases SCL alone; a NACK releases
both. Releasing both for the ACK ends
the burst after one byte AND moves SDA
